verses.text: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.

segments.text: Praise ye Jehovah.
Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah,

verses.text: Blessed be the name of Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.

segments.text: Blessed be the name of Jehovah

verses.text: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah’s name is to be praised.

segments.text: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same

verses.text: Jehovah is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.

segments.text: Jehovah is high above all nations,

verses.text: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, That hath his seat on high,

segments.text: Who is like unto Jehovah our God,
That hath his seat on high,

verses.text: That humbleth himself to behold The things that are in heaven and in the earth?

in heaven and in the earth?

verses.text: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy from the dunghill;

segments.text: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
And lifteth up the needy from the dunghill;

verses.text: That he may set him with princes, Even with the princes of his people.

segments.text: That he may set him with princes,

verses.text: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, And to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye Jehovah.
